name: Verify Ed25519 signature
description: Verify a detached Ed25519 signature over exact bytes. A well-formed signature mismatch returns valid:false; malformed encodings or lengths fail.

accountKey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 AccountKey/blob, or its hexadecimal JSON representation (optional 0x prefix). Not PEM or an X25519 key.

signature.description: 64-byte detached Ed25519 signature blob, or its hexadecimal JSON representation (optional 0x prefix).

data.description: Native blob bytes. JSON/MCP callers pass hexadecimal (0x prefix recommended), or select encoding:utf8/base64 for text input. No implicit hash, CAD3 conversion or JSON canonicalisation.

encoding.description: Applies to string input only: hex by default (optional 0x prefix), or explicit utf8/base64. Native ABlob input is used directly.
